recipes.title: Quick Chickpea Curry
steps: 1. Sauté curry powder in a pan with a splash of oil.
2. Add chickpeas and tomatoes, simmering for 10 minutes.
3. Stir in coconut milk and cook for 2 minutes.
4. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
steps: 1. Roast tomatoes in air fryer at 400F for 10 minutes.
2. Boil pasta until al dente.
3. Drain pasta and toss with pesto.
4. Top with roasted tomatoes and parmesan.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
steps: 1. Combine quinoa, cucumber, and olives in a bowl.
2. Drizzle with lemon juice.
3. Toss with feta cheese.
4. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka Skewers
steps: 1. Marinate paneer and peppers in yogurt and masala for 10 minutes.
2. Thread onto skewers.
3. Air fry at 375F for 10-12 minutes until charred.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan Bake
steps: 1. Lightly oil eggplant slices and bake in oven at 400F for 15 minutes.
2. Layer eggplant with marinara and mozzarella in a baking dish.
3. Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top.
4. Bake for 10 more minutes until cheese is bubbly.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Zucchini Pasta
steps: 1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté garlic and red pepper flakes.
3. Add zucchini ribbons and cook for 3 minutes.
4. Toss pasta into the skillet with lemon juice and parmesan.
5. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Aloo Gobi
steps: 1. Toss cauliflower and potatoes with oil and all spices.
2. Place in the air fryer basket.
3. Cook at 200°C (400°F) for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through.
4. Ensure vegetables are tender and slightly charred.
5. Serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Greek Chickpea Salad
steps: 1. Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, and onion in a large bowl.
2. Whisk olive oil and lemon juice together.
3. Pour dressing over the salad and toss well.
4. Top with crumbled feta cheese.
5. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
steps: 1. Pre-heat oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Boil pasta shells for 8 minutes; drain.
3. Mix ricotta, spinach, and nutmeg in a bowl.
4. Stuff each shell with the mixture and place in a baking dish covered with marinara.
5. Top with mozzarella and bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala with Basmati Rice
steps: 1. Cook basmati rice according to package instructions.
2. Sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste in a pan until golden.
3. Add tomato puree and garam masala, simmering for 10 minutes.
4. Stir in the cream and paneer cubes, cooking for 5 minutes.
5. Serve hot over the cooked rice.

recipes.title: Masala Spiced Chickpea Wraps
steps: 1. Heat chickpeas in a pan with garam masala for 5 minutes.
2. Lay out tortillas and spread yogurt on each.
3. Top with chickpeas, cucumber, and onion.
4. Roll up and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Caprese Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: 1. Mix quinoa, mozzarella, tomatoes, and pesto in a bowl.
2. Stuff mixture into bell pepper halves.
3. Air fry at 375F for 15 minutes until peppers are tender.
4. Drizzle with balsamic glaze before serving.

recipes.title: Mediterranean White Bean and Spinach Skillet
steps: 1. Sauté garlic in olive oil over medium heat.
2. Add beans and red pepper flakes; cook for 5 minutes.
3. Stir in spinach until wilted.
4. Remove from heat and top with feta.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato and Spinach Orzo
steps: 1. Simmer orzo in vegetable broth until liquid is mostly absorbed.
2. Stir in cream, parmesan, and oregano.
3. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
4. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Paneer and Bell Pepper Tawa Fry
steps: 1. Heat oil in a wide pan over high heat.
2. Sauté onions and bell peppers for 5 minutes.
3. Add spices and paneer cubes.
4. Toss for 5-7 minutes until paneer is golden brown.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Spinach and Lentil Dal
steps: 1. Rinse lentils and add to a pot with broth and turmeric.
2. Simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
3. In a small pan, heat ghee and sizzle cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
4. Stir the tempered cumin into the lentils.
5. Fold in spinach and cook until wilted.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Mediterranean Veggie Pita
steps: 1. Lightly toast pitas in the air fryer at 350F for 3 minutes.
2. Spread hummus inside the pita pockets.
3. Stuff with cucumber, olives, and feta.
4. Sprinkle with oregano and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Arrabbiata Penne
steps: 1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
2. Sauté garlic and chili flakes in a pan until fragrant.
3. Add marinara sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Toss cooked pasta into the sauce.
5. Top with parsley and parmesan.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower and Halloumi Sheet Pan
steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400F.
2. Toss cauliflower and onion with oil and paprika on a baking sheet.
3. Roast for 20 minutes.
4. Add halloumi slices to the pan.
5. Bake for another 8-10 minutes until cheese is golden.

recipes.title: Vegetable Jalfrezi with Basmati Rice
steps: 1. Cook basmati rice according to package instructions.
2. Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and peppers on high heat.
3. Add green beans and spices, cooking for 5 minutes.
4. Stir in tomato puree and simmer until vegetables are tender-crisp.
5. Serve hot over rice.
